title: Serve desktop renderer files
responsibility: Serve files beneath the renderer root with a content policy and fallback to the app entry page.

inputs.name: rendererPolicy.html
inputs.description: HTML source scanned for inline <script> elements whose bodies are added to script-src as SHA-256 hashes. Only bodies matching the case-sensitive script pattern are included.

inputs.name: rendererPolicy.connect
inputs.description: Optional CSP source text appended verbatim to connect-src after 'self' when nonempty; this function does not parse or validate it. Defaults to the empty string.

inputs.name: rendererPolicy.planningImages
inputs.description: Allows HTTPS images in the Plans and schedule document while retaining the existing script, frame and connection policy.

inputs.name: rendererAssets.root
inputs.description: Filesystem root used to resolve the requested asset and the index.html fallback. The resolved file must remain inside this root, and failure to resolve the root rejects the request.

inputs.name: rendererAssets.url
inputs.description: Absolute URL parsed to select a renderer asset; only the harness: scheme with hostname app is accepted. The decoded pathname is refused if it contains NUL or a .. path segment; query and fragment do not select the file.

inputs.name: rendererAssets.connect
inputs.description: Optional CSP source text passed to rendererPolicy and appended verbatim to connect-src when nonempty; it is not validated as a CSP source here. Defaults to the empty string.

outputs.name: rendererPolicy
outputs.description: Content-Security-Policy text with SHA-256 sources for inline script bodies matching the function's script pattern and an optional connect-src addition. The remaining directives restrict scripts, styles, images, media, fonts, frames, objects, and base URLs.
examples: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' ; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' blob: data:; media-src 'self' blob:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; frame-src 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'

outputs.name: rendererAssets
outputs.description: Resolves to a Fetch Response containing the selected file bytes, extension-based Content-Type (or application/octet-stream), Content-Security-Policy, and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff. Invalid origins, decoded traversal paths, and real files outside root return 403 Refused; a non-file or failed initial stat selects index.html.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Malformed absolute URLs and response headers rejected by Response raise TypeError; connect text containing forbidden header characters can cause the latter.

errors.name: URIError
errors.description: A percent-encoded pathname that decodeURIComponent cannot decode raises URIError.

errors.name: Renderer asset path resolution or read failure
errors.description: Filesystem failures while resolving the selected file or root, or reading the selected file, reject rendererAssets; failures from its initial stat are caught and instead select index.html.
